HexCoord.description:
Axial hex coordinate (q, r).

Supports tuple-like comparison and indexing for migration compatibility:
- h == (x, y) returns True if coordinates match
- h[0] == h.q, h[1] == h.r
- hash(h) == hash((x, y))

OverwatchOpportunity.description:
A detected overwatch opportunity for a single enemy.

This represents one enemy's ability to potentially react with overwatch
when a combatant starts movement in their weapon's threat range.

reactor_id.description: ID of enemy who can react
reactor_id.title: Reactor Id

can_react.description: True if reactor has available reaction budget
can_react.title: Can React

OverwatchOpportunity.title: OverwatchOpportunity

description:
Result of checking overwatch triggers at movement start.

Per PR2 rules, this check happens BEFORE movement occurs - the trigger
condition is starting movement inside threat range, not entering it.

reactions_prevented.description: True if mover's status prevents all overwatch reactions
reactions_prevented.title: Reactions Prevented

prevention_reason.description: Global reason if all reactions are prevented
prevention_reason.title: Prevention Reason
